The '''awakened altars''' can spawn on the north, east, south and west wall of Skotizo's lair during the fight against [[Skotizo]]. These altars reduce all damage inflicted on Skotizo while they are active. If [[Arclight]] or [[Emberlight]] is equipped, each altar reduces damage by 15% up to a maximum of 60%. Otherwise, with other weapons, it's 25% each up to a maximum of 100%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1268258495322824709|date=3 June 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100828|archivedate=6 July 2020|quote=Correct. If you're wielding arclight, each altar reduces damage by 15% up to a maximum of 60%. Otherwise it's 25%, up to a maximum of 100%.}} They have 100 [[Hitpoints]] each. Hitting the awakened altars with Arclight/Emberlight will instantly disable them in one hit, regardless of the player's stats and gear.

At the beginning of the fight, each of the four altars sets a timer with a random duration between 50 and 129 ticks (30 and 77.4 seconds) inclusive.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1217549945504509952|date=15 January 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/103032|archivedate=25 June 2023|quote=50 - 129 ticks inclusive, chosen independently for each of the four altars. (...)}} Whenever one of these timers ticks down to zero, the corresponding altar will be reawakened if it had previously been deactivated.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1217554158447931393|date=15 January 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109196|archivedate=24 June 2023|quote=I've had a closer look. It's running a check every X ticks, where X is set as described above. If it finds an inactive altar at that time, it activates it. So it's a sort of maximum duration before one can respawn.}} When an altar is deactivated, it goes on cooldown for a minute before it can be reactivated.
